entries.title: PERMANENTLY SATISFIED.
entries.subtitle: REST ASSURED — TREATMENT COMPLETE
body: You have achieved permanent relaxation. The House is delighted to report that its newest customer has stopped complaining.
entries.narrativeBeat: You have achieved permanent relaxation. The House is delighted to report that its newest customer has stopped complaining.

entries.title: CLASSIFIED AS COMPOST.
entries.subtitle: MATERIAL PROCESSED
body: The groundskeeper has converted your unsuccessful escape into a successful disposal. It records the improvement without requesting a signature.
entries.narrativeBeat: The groundskeeper has converted your unsuccessful escape into a successful disposal. It records the improvement without requesting a signature.

entries.title: NEW ARRIVAL.
entries.subtitle: PLANTED SUCCESSFULLY
body: The Park welcomes its newest addition. Your commemorative marker is installed before anyone notices the visitor is missing.
entries.narrativeBeat: The Park welcomes its newest addition. Your commemorative marker is installed before anyone notices the visitor is missing.

entries.title: PERSONAL GROWTH.
entries.subtitle: CULTIVATION SUCCESSFUL
body: The Park has improved your relationship with nature considerably. There is no recognizable visitor left to dispute the result.
entries.narrativeBeat: The Park has improved your relationship with nature considerably. There is no recognizable visitor left to dispute the result.

entries.title: RECLASSIFIED.
entries.subtitle: PLANTING MATERIAL ACCEPTED
body: You attempted to leave through the waste hatch. The planting system has found a more productive destination for you.
entries.narrativeBeat: You attempted to leave through the waste hatch. The planting system has found a more productive destination for you.

entries.title: SITE IMPROVEMENT.
entries.subtitle: NEW UNDERGROUND FIXTURE APPROVED
body: The roots finish sealing the service duct. Above you, the translator requests another buried fixture without bothering to ask its name.
entries.narrativeBeat: The roots finish sealing the service duct. Above you, the translator requests another buried fixture without bothering to ask its name.

entries.title: FINAL OCCUPANCY
body: The collection crew reports that Lot Fifty-Three has suffered considerable damage during removal. The associated toilet is declared beyond repair. Your restroom visit is recorded as COMPLETED. The auctioneer considers this an excellent example of customer satisfaction.
entries.narrativeBeat: The collection crew reports that Lot Fifty-Three has suffered considerable damage during removal. The associated toilet is declared beyond repair. Your restroom visit is recorded as COMPLETED. The auctioneer considers this an excellent example of customer satisfaction.

entries.title: PRESSED AND STEAMED
body: The emergency pressure test has passed. Your formalwear has never looked better. Unfortunately, its former occupant is unavailable for comment.
entries.narrativeBeat: The emergency pressure test has passed. Your formalwear has never looked better. Unfortunately, its former occupant is unavailable for comment.

entries.title: FOLDED FOR CONVENIENCE
body: Lot Sixty-One has been successfully reduced to its transport dimensions. The collection crew reports that the unit is somewhat heavier than the manufacturer's specifications suggest. The auction clerk adds a note to the manifest: CONTENTS INCLUDED. No further inspection is deemed necessary.
entries.narrativeBeat: Lot Sixty-One has been successfully reduced to its transport dimensions. The collection crew reports that the unit is somewhat heavier than the manufacturer's specifications suggest. The auction clerk adds a note to the manifest: CONTENTS INCLUDED. No further inspection is deemed necessary.

entries.title: MADE TO MEASURE
body: The AutoFit system guarantees a perfect silhouette. Breathing room is available at additional cost.
entries.narrativeBeat: The AutoFit system guarantees a perfect silhouette. Breathing room is available at additional cost.
